paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 图表小作文首段：题目改写与总体趋势概览（Paraphrase + Macro Overview）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 或数据报告的第一段：用同义句法改写图表标题，并用两句话高度凝练全图最核心的 2 个宏观趋势（极值、反超拐点或主次格局），绝不堆砌零碎数字。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Paraphrase -> Overall Trajectory Contrast -> Dominant Crossover/Extremum (Zero raw numbers in Overview!). 绑定逻辑规则：L013, L015.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: The line graph compares the proportion of electricity generated from four fuel sources across three industrial economies between 2000 and 2025. Overall, renewable sources—particularly solar and wind power—followed a pronounced upward trajectory over the 25-year span, whereas coal reliance contracted steadily. Most notably, clean energy generation overtook fossil-fuel consumption around 2018, shifting from a marginal supplement to the dominant power supply by the end of the period.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 流程图/算法流水线与闭环工序衔接段（Process & Closed-Loop Lifecycle）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 工艺/自然循环流程图（或论文算法数据预处理与闭环训练流水线）：把 5–6 个串联、分叉与回环步骤写得层次分明，绝不机械连用 Then, Then, Then。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Pipeline Overview -> Ingestion & Filtering -> Parallel Bifurcation -> Terminal Merger & Feedback Loop. 绑定逻辑规则：L003, L005.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: The diagram illustrates the closed-loop data curation pipeline for embodied robot learning, spanning four primary stages from teleoperated collection to failure-driven retraining. The cycle begins when raw multimodal demonstrations are recorded via VR teleoperation and filtered to discard kinematic singularities and dropped frames. Once validated, the trajectory stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: visual frames undergo background augmentation, while proprioceptive states are normalized into local gripper coordinates. These processed streams are subsequently synchronized to train the visuomotor policy, whose real-world rollout failures are logged and fed back into the teleoperation buffer to close the active-learning loop.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 历史实测与未来预测跨时态衔接段（Historical vs. Projected Trends）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想处理同时包含过去历史数据（如 2010–2025）和未来预测数据（如 2026–2040）的图表段落，严格区分过去实测时态与未来审慎预测表达。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Historical Past (rose/accounted for) -> Pivot Year -> Future Projection Verbs (is projected/anticipated/expected to) -> Moderating Factor. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L017.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Between 2010 and 2025, global data-center electricity consumption more than doubled from 200 TWh to 460 TWh. From 2026 onward, total demand is projected to climb at a substantially steeper rate, with baseline forecasts pointing to 1,050 TWh by 2035. Within this expansion, AI model training and inference—which represented under 10% of server load in 2023—are anticipated to account for nearly half (46%) of total consumption by 2040. However, widespread deployment of sparsity-aware accelerators is expected to temper the annual growth rate after 2035.
